title: NetBird community project
description: One file per project under data/projects/<slug>.yaml. The filename slug is the stable id.

description.description: One or two sentences describing what the project does. No marketing fluff.

author.description: Person or organization that maintains the project.

category.description: Apps = run/deploy NetBird somewhere; Extensions = plug into another tool; Interfaces = ways to view/drive NetBird; Tools = automate/manage via code.

url.description: Canonical link to the project (repository or homepage).

badge.description: official = built/maintained by the NetBird team. endorsed = a community project the NetBird team vouches for. Omit for a standard community listing.
